steps.title: Five hundred smart containers on a Friday evening
steps.say: An invented district: 500 containers across four streams on a 6 km street grid, eight weeks of six-hourly fill readings and pickups under a fixed weekly schedule, six trucks, five recovery facilities and weekly material prices. Each container's fill rate by weekday is estimated from its own readings and back-tested on the last week against a constant rate. The response also says what the service does not know: a festival starts tonight near the venue.

steps.title: The gateway delivers Saturday morning
steps.say: Twelve hours of readings arrive and the clock moves to Saturday 06:00. Then three readings pushed by hand: one valid, one from a sensor nobody registered, one that claims 140% full. Each is accepted or refused on its own.

steps.title: Weekend overflow risk
steps.say: Every container's chance of overflowing in 8, 24 and 48 hours from its last reading and its own weekday rates. Parks and the venue lead, as weekends do; the containers near the festival are filling faster than any weekday rate predicts, which the risk list shows as high fill now and a steep expected curve. The hidden truth is beside it: how many would really overflow if nothing were collected, how many the list caught, and how many it missed.

steps.title: Dynamic routes against the fixed schedule
steps.say: The policy collects every container with at least a 30% chance of overflowing in 24 hours or an expected fill of 80%. A capacitated VRP routes them over the six trucks, two trips each, each truck only its streams, four hours a trip. Beside it, the fixed Saturday schedule run nearest-first. Kilometres, fuel, tonnes, and on the hidden truth: overflows each plan leaves for tomorrow.

steps.title: Conveyor frames and a contamination alert
steps.say: Twelve frames from the recycling line, classified by a toy: colour histograms of schematic images into gradient-boosted trees, with its held-out accuracy shown. Three frames are contamination (black film, red specks), a quarter of the batch, and the alert fires at 10%. The page says plainly that this is not a vision model for real cameras.

steps.title: A facility fills up and a stream is redirected
steps.say: Facility capacity before and after today's loads. The destination optimiser places each planned trip's material where value less haul cost is best within what each facility can still take: Northgate MRF, the nearer plant, reaches its daily capacity and the rest of the recycling goes on to Riverbend MRF rather than to the transfer station's gate fee; organics go to the compost plant although the transfer station is closer. Beside it, the nearest-accepting-facility rule, which would have sent every load to the transfer station. With apply, the deliveries are recorded.

steps.title: The audit trail
steps.say: Who loaded, polled, pushed readings, planned the routes, classified frames, raised the alert and routed the material: a hash-chained log.
